answer: Give each agent a single opal seal that is earned only by completing a supervised tundra field task recorded at a shared lagoon checkpoint, and let the seal expire unless the agent renews it with fresh verified work. A clone that copies another agent's seal is rejected because the checkpoint record belongs to one body of work, not to a name, so an attacker wanting 180 fake agents must complete 180 separate field tasks, each costing 55 coins in supervision and travel, for 9,900 coins in total, and any seal caught being lent out is cancelled with its fee kept.
